ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’ · also ’thought of, devised (a thing)’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέστη: ἐφίστημι — set upon; aor. 3 sg. act. intrans.: ’stood beside, stood over’
ἐπέσχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aorist ἐπέσχον): ’checked’ · also ’cover, extend over’, of space: ’covered’ (ἑπτὰ … ἐπέσχε πέλεθρα ’covered seven plethra’)
ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they obeyed’
ἐπιμὶξ: ἐπιμίξ — in confusion, mixed together; adv. (cf. μίγνυμι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρέων: ἐρέω (= ἐρωτάω) — ask, inquire after; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρωτῶν), + acc. of the thing: ’asking after’ · also ἐρέω (fut. of εἶπον) — say, tell; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρῶν), of purpose: ’to tell’ (ἔπος ἐρέων ’to tell a word’)
ἐρίβωλον: ἐρίβωλος — rich-soiled, fertile; fem. acc. sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
ἐϋζώνους: ἐΰζωνος — well-girdled; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. pl.
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἑανῷ: ἑανός — fine, soft; as noun, a fine robe; masc. dat. sg.
ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑσταότες: ἵστημι — set up; perf. stand; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic ἑσταότες (= Attic ἑστῶτες): ’standing’
ἑτάροιο: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of cause after a verb of anger · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of cause after ἄχος: ’for the comrade’ (ἄχος … ἑτάροιο ’grief for the comrade’) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, dependent on χερσί: ’of the companion’
ἑτέρωσε: ἑτέρωσε — to the other side, to one side; adv.
ἓ: ἕ, οὗ, οἷ — him, her, it(self); 3rd-person pron., acc. sg., reflexive: ’himself’
ἔβαλλον: βάλλω — throw, pelt, hit; impf. 3 pl. (1 sg. identical): ’kept pelting’
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔβαν (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔλαιον: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. nom. sg., after ἠΰτε: ’like oil’
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + gen. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νήσων ἔπι ’to the islands’)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤρυκε): ’held back’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act., with μή: ’do not hold back’ (μὴ … ἔρυκε)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν) · also with σύν in tmesis: σὺν … ἔχευαν ’poured together, confounded’ (of oaths)
ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕζεσθαι: ἕζομαι — sit, seat oneself; pres. inf. mid.
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο): ’were gathering’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἡνιόχοιο: ἡνίοχος — charioteer, driver; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’came, went’
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adj., agreeing with τείχεα: ’sacred (walls)’
ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 3 dual (strong aor., ἱκέσθην), + acc. of goal: ’the two came to’
ἱππεῦσιν: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable (= ἱππεῦσι)
ἱππῆας: ἱππεύς — horseman; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic ἱππέας)
ἱρῶν: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. gen. pl. as a noun: ’of the sacred rites’
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵπποισίν: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), accented before enclitic μ’
ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’ · also acc. sg., of a single horse in apposition to a name: ’the horse’ (Πήδασον … ἵππον ’Pedasus the horse’)
ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
ὀδύρετο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ὀρέοντο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; mid. rise up, hasten; ὀρέοντο, Homeric 3 pl. mid. (impf. in force): ’rose up, hastened’
ὀρθωθεὶς: ὀρθόω — set upright, raise; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg., middle sense: ’having raised himself, sitting up’
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄρουσεν: ὀρούω — rush, dart, spring; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’rushed’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμαδος: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. nom. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’ · also ὅς τις in an indirect question, masc. acc. sg.: ’what’ (νόον ὅν τιν’ ἔχουσιν ’what mind they have’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, liquid, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’liquid’
ὑψηλόν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὕδατι: ὕδωρ — water; neut. dat. sg., of means
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’) · also postpositive + gen. of cause: ’because of’ (ἀνδροκτασίης ὕπο ’because of a slaying’)
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
